plan.goal: Generate and triage one compact de novo soluble protein candidate with sequence, structure evidence, QC, and final ranking.
assumptions: A short single-chain de novo monomer of about 60 residues is an acceptable proxy for a small soluble candidate.
The runtime can promote upstream canonical candidates into the backbone and input representations expected by downstream design and prediction tools.
A single backbone, single designed sequence, and single-seed structure prediction are sufficient for a compact first-pass workflow.
